BrochureContent.Content:
Garrett O Bric Property Advisers proudly present this truly impressive, 3 bed family home to the market. Number 32 has been extensively refurbished and upgraded over the years by the current owners, with results that have created a really wonderful contemporary home perfect for your family. This home offers exceptional living and storage space with accommodation extending to just under 95 square metres offering a blend of modern comforts and timeless design. The interiors are stunning, having been decorated with a tasteful flair for quality and design, the colour schemes are faultless and create a warm and welcoming ambience that flows throughout this lovely light filled home. Upon entering this desirable home, the high quality finish, which is continued throughout is immediately apparent. On arrival you are greeted by an attractive open plan front garden providing plenty of off street parking, a cosy composite hall door opens to a welcoming hallway with built in smart storage keeping the hallway clutter free and a convenient guest wc. The entire of the ground floor boasts stunning opulent herringbone timber floors that flow seamlessly throughout adding to the sense of space and light. Off the hallway is an elegant living room that is refined yet boasts a comfortable atmosphere, a cosy feature fireplace is framed by striking bespoke cabinet, while double doors here can be left open to create an open plan feel with the kitchen diner while remaining closed to provide an intimate separate living room. The wonderful kitchen diner effortlessly flows into the south west facing garden and patio providing seamless indoor to outdoor living. The kitchen is well equipped for all your cooking and dining requirements. Rising to the upper level via a wonderful staircase with wall panelling and luxury carpeting creating a sense of grandeur. The first floor is home to three generous bedrooms, two doubles and a single, the luxurious primary is complete with a stylish ensuite and all bedrooms boast fitted wardrobes. The accommodation is completed by a sumptuous family bathroom which has been recently upgraded with extensive tiling and high quality sanitary ware creating a spa like experience. One of the many fantastic features of this fabulous home is the magnificent south west facing rear garden, landscaped with an extensive low maintenance composite decked patio area creating a wonderful outdoor dining room. Full Planning Permission has been granted to extend the footprint of the property should the need arise. 
This wonderful home is set in a family friendly convenient location, tucked away just off the Boghall Road, Giltspur Brook is within minutes walk of local amenities including shops, cafes, doctors surgery and chemist. An array of local schools both primary and secondary are within walking distance, while excellent public transport links including an array of Dublin Bus services plus DART and mainline rail can provide a seamless commute to surrounding areas. By car, the M11 is just moments away providing speedy access to the M50 and surrounding areas while Dublin City Centre is less than 20 kilometres away. 
Number 32 Giltspur Brook will surely prove popular, so early viewing is highly recommended with appointments available immediately.

Accommodation 

A cosy composite hall door in contemporary sable provides access to this lovely home, keeping your home cosy and warm while safe and secure. 

Entrance Hallway 
This bright welcoming hallway sets the tone perfectly, the light filled space boasts warm wide plank timber flooring at foot creating a stylish statement. The understairs area boasts Beneath stair storage providing ample storage for coats and shoes and keeps your hallway clutter free. A staircase rises to the upper level and creates a striking statement with a stunning herringbone carpet runner with taped edge creating a luxurious touch. The staircase features aesthetic appeal with wall panelling creating a custom high end feature and making the space feel wider. 

Guest WC 
This handy ground floor guest wc is home to high quality sanitary ware in classic white finished with high gloss brick wall effect tiling also in white and finished with striking patterned floor tiles in contemporary shades. 

Living Room 
3.3 x 4.8m 
This elegant living space is flooded with natural light from a wonderful bay window overlooking the front garden. A delightful feature stone fireplace is home to a gas fire inset and creates a stylish cosy central focus point. With stylish design in mind, the current owners have added bespoke handcrafted cabinetry to create a home for your television and organising media devices while concealing messy cables and enhancing the rooms overall aesthetic. The room is finished with luxurious herringbone timber flooring that flows seamlessly to the kitchen diner. Double doors here can be left open to create an open plan feel with the kitchen diner and remaining closed can provide an intimate separate living room. 

Kitchen Diner Living Room 
5.4 x 3.3m plus 2.7 x 2.3m 
Stunning spacious L shaped open plan room boasts plenty of room for designated kitchen, dining and living room areas. Perfect for entertaining and everyday life the dining area enjoys direct access to the living room with the stunning herringbone flooring continued adding a sense of space and light. Here French doors open directly to the rear garden and patio, flooding the room with natural light and bringing the outside inside. The kitchen area is well equipped for all your cooking needs with an extensive range of Shaker style cabinets boasting plenty of countertop space for food prep, integrated appliances include a Zanussi oven, a gas hob with extractor fan overhead plus a handy dishwasher. For ease of maintenance the splashback is finished with tiling in a neutral shade. 

First Floor Level: 
The wonderful herringbone carpeting is continued from the staircase to the landing creating an opulent approach to your bedroom accommodation. The hotpress here provides an abundance of linen storage. 

Primary Bedroom 
2.9 x 4.9m 
This wonderful bright primary suite boasts open aspect overlooking the front garden and peaceful cul de sac below, this spacious room boasts wonderful cabinetry with floor to ceiling wardrobes providing ample storage. The room is complete with warm timber flooring. The ensuite shower room has been recently upgraded with style and luxury in mind creating a sumptuous ensuite with extensive tiling and high end sanitary ware including wc, wash hand basin and shower cubicle with an Aquastream electric shower, a chrome plated heated towel rail finishes the room perfectly. 

Bedroom No. 2 
3.3 x 3m 
This generous double bedroom enjoys a pleasing outlook over the rear garden below, the room is home to an excellent range of floor to ceiling fitted wardrobes. Access to the attic here is provided by a pull down stira stairs adding super storage. 

Bedroom No. 3 
2.5 x 2.8m 
Single bedroom complete again with fitted wardrobes adding plenty of storage, the room is bright with a window overlooking the front of the property and cul de sac below. 

Bathroom 
Again the family bathroom has undergone a recent upgrade with truly wonderful results creating a sumptuous, sophisticated bathroom, boasting high quality sanitary ware in classic white, including a three piece suite with the bath featuring a Triton electric shower overhead screened by a glazed shower screen, teamed with flawless tiling in contemporary grey. A chrome plated towel heater keeps the room warm and cosy. 

Outside: 
This home is sure to impress both inside and out, approached by an open plan front garden which provides ample off street parking adjoining well kept lawns. An enclosed side entrance adds the perfect outdoor storage for bikes, outside toys, refuse and provides access to the private rear garden. Here peace and privacy is assured by high timber fencing that encompasses the garden. A clever scheme of landscaping creates a wonderful outdoor space that includes an extensive low maintenance composite decked patio creating a super outdoor dining space ideal for entertaining or just the perfect space to sit back and relax and make the most of this gardens sunny south westerly orientation. The garden is complete with tiered lawns for children to play while flowerbeds are brimming over with colourful plants and shrubs plus a feature cherry blossom tree. A pathway leads to an attractive large Barna type timber shed providing an abundance of outdoor storage.
